Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 107: March 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #107 shipped to subscribers in February 2010 (bearing the cover date of March 2010 for Issue 107). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #107 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Split/Second (arcade racing)
Blur (power-up arcade racing)
Supreme Commander 2 (real-time strategy)
Prison Break: The Conspiracy (action-adventure stealth)
Room Boomer (Xbox Live Arcade physics puzzle)
Lazy Raiders (Xbox Live Arcade action-puzzle)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Gears of War 3, Fallout: New Vegas, and Fable III, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
